documents.title: Report of the Agent General of the United Nations Korean Reconstruction Agency, 1 Oct 1953–1 Sep 1954
documents.institution: UN Korean Reconstruction Agency, Agent General John B. Coulter
documents.document_number: A/2750, GAOR Ninth Session Supplement No.20
documents.extraction_method: TinyFish PDF full text (OCR, 213635 characters); not relying on snippets
documents.kind: official contemporary full report and annexes

findings.finding: 1954-05-31 ROK-UNKRA agreement retroactively established hwan counterpart deposits; policies jointly determined. Korean govt to create UNKRA counterpart fund, funds used only with Agent General approval; separate Aid Goods Collection Account by mutual agreement.

1953 joint UNKRA-Social Affairs Ministry housing plan approximately 5,000 permanent homes, 2,500 Seoul; 210 started, 106 completed during 1953; 1954 Aug Seoul cumulative 330 complete and 148 under construction; Korean Housing Administration local currency shortage delayed works.
1953+1954 combined 9,000-9,500 units intended, 2,000 in Busan, plan not completion.

Tongnae rehabilitation center for 300-350 disabled veterans/civilians, started 1953 jointly with ROK Ministry of Social Affairs and American-Korean Foundation; some buildings repaired, training under way, full completion not claimed.
1953 Small Business Loan Fund assets $15m + 230m hwan, board approved $441,500 +79m hwan loans by Sep1954; approval not necessarily disbursement.
Financial audit 1954-06-30 still being prepared, Annex I offers and contributions through 1954-08-31.
2,384 provincial/Seoul project site entries across sectors, NOT completed project counts; table OCR alignment poor, verify scan for precise rows.

documents.source_caveat: Contemporaneous report is UNKRA's institutional account, not independent Korean executive or recipient audit. Verify with CA0002578, Seoul housing ledger and Korean finance records.
